clean_description: The Hunger Games follows 16-year-old Katniss Everdeen in the dystopian nation of Panem, where the Capitol exerts control over the districts. Each year, the Capitol hosts the Hunger Games, a brutal televised competition where one boy and one girl from each district fight to the death. Katniss volunteers to take her sister's place in the Games, leading her to navigate complex themes of survival, sacrifice, and rebellion.
